facts.fact: Migration: Aliyun ECS (systemd + local SQLite) → Tencent CloudBase 云托管 (container) + CloudBase MySQL. Zero code fork: DB_KIND env var switches storage driver; unset = sqlite = ECS path stays bit-identical (rollback = just unset DB_KIND).

Enable CloudBase MySQL in the SAME env (内网互通, no public-bandwidth cost). Record 内网地址/端口/账号/密码/库名; DB advised utf8mb4. Tables optional: engine first-connect runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS self-bootstrap. If pre-creating: import scripts/mysql_schema.sql — must be maintained in sync with store.py _SCHEMA (change tables in BOTH places).

Two deploy routes: A (recommended) 云托管 console direct build — create service (e.g. qianwen-engine, memory 1G+), upload local code / Git with ROOT DIR = services/qianwen-engine/ (Dockerfile there is auto-detected). B: local build + push: docker build -t ccr.ccs.tencentyun.com/<命名空间>/qianwen-engine:v080 . && docker push, then service creation via 镜像拉取.

Dockerfile: FROM python:3.11-slim; ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PORT=8080; WORKDIR /app; apt-get install --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk fontconfig (CJK font for poster/export, same /usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto path as ECS); COPY requirements.txt + pip install --no-cache-dir; COPY report_content → ./report_platform/content (content layer placed BEFORE code layer so code iterations don't bust the cache; engine default REPORT_CONTENT_DIR=/app/report_platform/content); COPY qianwen_engine; COPY docker-entrypoint.sh; COPY fonts → ./data/fonts; RUN mkdir -p /app/data/wxacode /app/secrets; useradd --create-home appuser + chown data/secrets + USER appuser (comment: delete those lines if volume permissions are restricted); EXPOSE 8080; ENTRYPOINT ["sh","/app/docker-entrypoint.sh"]; CMD ["sh","-c","exec uvicorn qianwen_engine.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8080}"]

Baked into image: 64 sellable report PDFs ≈92MB (Dockerfile comment, v0.9.0 era) + report.json + sample/ trial readings. Current live staging measured 119M total with 64 PDFs in report_content/full. Fonts baked: NotoSansSC-Bold.otf, NotoSansSC-Regular.otf, simhei.ttf → /app/data/fonts. PDF inclusion cap = 20MB per file (REPORT_PDF_MAX_BYTES default 20*1024*1024; TOPIC-06 at >136MB excluded).

One-shot migration ECS SQLite → CloudBase MySQL: set MYSQL_* env vars then `python scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_mysql.py /path/to/data/qianwen/db.sqlite` (--fresh to TRUNCATE first). Script sets DB_KIND=mysql BEFORE importing store (config reads env at import); opens sqlite read-only via URI mode=ro (never writes source); DDL reuses engine runtime bootstrap (store.init, no drift); 12 tables in order: users, answers, mp_session, rewards, pot_items, followups, posters, pot_reports, citations_ft, criticisms, pay_log, pay_order; criticisms lazy-DDL duplicated in script; inserts follow sqlite rowid order (answers insert order = mysql rowid order, history sort semantics preserved); autoincrement ids (rewards/followups/criticisms) preserved raw; chunked executemany 500 rows; refuses non-empty target tables by default (anti double-load).

Must run single replica: progress stream (typewriter/stage events, _PROGRESS) and KB serial gate are in-process state → pin 实例数=1、弹性伸缩关. Multi-replica requires externalizing both states (MySQL/Redis) first.

MySQL mode pool: _POOL_MAX=4 (write path has separate _LOCK serial, low concurrency, small pool suffices); borrow does conn.ping(reconnect=True) self-heal for container idle disconnects; exception-path connections are discarded not returned; connect params charset=utf8mb4, autocommit=False, connect_timeout=5, read_timeout=60, write_timeout=60, DictCursor. Container idle disconnect/restart auto-recovers, no manual ops.

config.py TCB detection is structural: REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] (repo root) with IndexError fallback to parents[1] — inside container /app/qianwen_engine/config.py has only 2 parent levels → REPO=/app, so DATA_DIR/SECRETS_DIR defaults land at /app/data, /app/secrets. Env overrides: SECRETS_DIR, DATA_DIR (DB_PATH=DATA_DIR/db.sqlite), REPORT_CONTENT_DIR (default REPO/report_platform/content). No secrets ever in config.py (comment: 本文件不落任何密钥). _env_int tolerates missing/invalid int values (falls back to default).

gotchas.symptom: `tcb run service:config -s qianwen-engine --envParams ...` always fails with INVALID_PARAM "请使用 -e 或 --envId 指定环境 ID" exit_code 3 (stack: throwInvalidParam → checkTcbrEnv → ConfigServiceTcbr.execute), even when -e is passed at root or patched into options
gotchas.root_cause: CLI 3.8.5 structural dead end (source-level verified): ① the command's options never declare an envId flag so options.envId is always undefined (flag at root position or patch-injected both fail; InjectParams does not merge); ② even with envId injected, client checkTcbrEnv rejects non-tcbr envs a second time. Log also shows the command is deprecated: '[已废弃] 此命令将被移除，新版云托管无独立的配置更新命令'
gotchas.fix: Use @cloudbase/manager-node cloudrun.deploy (UpdateCloudRunServer + DiffConfigItems sparse update) with EnvParams as JSON string — see TCB_DEPLOY.md §8a and data/state/mn_client/update_envparams.js. Alternative printed by CLI itself: redeploy via `tcb cloudrun deploy` or edit in console

gotchas.symptom: Env var value set via CLI --envParams gets silently truncated at the first '=' inside the value (e.g. base64 padding)
gotchas.root_cause: CLI flag parsing splits KEY=VALUE on '=' without maxsplit; and the new cloudrun deploy does not expose envParams at all
gotchas.fix: manager-node serverConfig.EnvParams JSON-string channel has no '=' truncation — base64 padding need not be stripped; entrypoint also re-pads stripped b64 defensively

gotchas.symptom: After a manager-node deploy(), public/miniapp access types drift — an unwanted 'OA' access type appears
gotchas.root_cause: deploy() update branch does NOT expand/inherit old config; OpenAccessTypes omitted from serverConfig falls back to default ['OA','PUBLIC','MINIAPP']
gotchas.fix: Always explicitly pass OpenAccessTypes:['PUBLIC','MINIAPP'] in serverConfig (other keys absent from sparse Items = server untouched, measured zero drift)

gotchas.symptom: Non-interactive `tcb cloudrun deploy` hangs at '? 是否启用灰度部署？ (Use arrow keys)'
gotchas.root_cause: CLI prompts interactively for gray-release choice even with --wait --force
gotchas.fix: Pipe a newline to accept the default 否 (auto traffic switch after success): printf '\n' | tcb cloudrun deploy ...

gotchas.symptom: 真机「付款解锁调不出收款码」— virtual payment rejected by WeChat side (1009 incident)
gotchas.root_cause: virtual_pay.secret env was flipped to 0 (prod) too early: pay items not yet published live + miniprogram not yet released → prod env payments rejected outright
gotchas.fix: env=0 only allowed during HANDOFF §六 release-chain step 4 (after 过审 + miniprogram release + 6 items published live); qw_tcb_prep.py hard-gates: aborts on env=0 unless data/state/VPAY_PROD_LIVE.flag exists (content = publisher/date). As of 1009 flag absent → sandbox env=1 still live

gotchas.symptom: Scaling to multiple replicas would corrupt live behavior (lost/interleaved typewriter progress, KB gate bypass)
gotchas.root_cause: _PROGRESS stream state and KB serial gate are in-process memory (single uvicorn worker)
gotchas.fix: Pin 实例数=1、弹性伸缩关 (deploy uses --min-num 1 --max-num 2 documented; engine comment says fix to 1); externalize both states to MySQL/Redis before multi-replica

gotchas.symptom: All users logged out after redeploy/secret change; every issued token rejected
gotchas.root_cause: qianwen_engine_hmac.key (user token HMAC key) lost or rotated — tokens are signed with it
gotchas.fix: Persist the key file (SECRETS_DIR mount or SECRET_FILES_B64 entry); never regenerate casually; rotation = forced logout of all users

gotchas.symptom: Container sits idle then MySQL queries fail once
gotchas.root_cause: CloudBase MySQL server drops idle connections; container keeps stale pooled conns
gotchas.fix: Already self-healing: _my_borrow does conn.ping(reconnect=True) on every borrow; exception-path connections discarded not returned; pool capped at 4

gotchas.symptom: docx/pdf export or poster endpoints return 503 in a fresh deployment
gotchas.root_cause: Chinese fonts absent — fonts must sit in DATA_DIR/fonts (or image /app/data/fonts): NotoSansSC-Bold/Regular.otf + simhei.ttf; system layer needs fonts-noto-cjk + fontconfig
gotchas.fix: Keep fonts in the baked image layer (Dockerfile COPY fonts ./data/fonts) and/or mount DATA_DIR with fonts/; Q&A main chain is unaffected by missing fonts

gotchas.symptom: Migration script aborts: '[abort] 目标库非空（防重复灌数）'
gotchas.root_cause: Intentional guard — any non-empty target table blocks the run to prevent double-loading
gotchas.fix: Confirm truly re-loading, then add --fresh (TRUNCATEs all target tables in reverse TABLES order first)

gotchas.symptom: Secret-materialization failure surfaces as container crash loop instead of a soft error
gotchas.root_cause: docker-entrypoint.sh runs `set -e`; the b64/JSON decode is inline — any malformed SECRET_FILES_B64 kills the container (by design, per verify step: 'entrypoint set -e，落盘失败容器必崩' so health check exposes it)
gotchas.fix: Treat /api/health failing after deploy as secret-injection failure; fix the EnvParams JSON/b64 at the source (qw_tcb_prep.py roundtrip asserts prevent this upstream)

gotchas.symptom: Env vars changed via console/manager-node disappear or seem stale after a CLI deploy
gotchas.root_cause: Actually the opposite is documented: `tcb cloudrun deploy` does NOT reset EnvParams (detail shows EnvParams at data.ServerConfig.EnvParams as JSON string). Stale reads usually mean checking the wrong place or a deploy still in ReleaseVersion phase
gotchas.fix: Read back via `tcb cloudrun detail -s qianwen-engine --json` and parse data.ServerConfig.EnvParams; wait for record list status normal + HasTraffic before verifying

gotchas.symptom: Schema drift between pre-created MySQL tables and engine runtime tables
gotchas.root_cause: mysql_schema.sql and store.py _SCHEMA are two hand-maintained copies (criticisms additionally lazy-created at runtime by save_criticism)
gotchas.fix: Always change both files together; engine bootstrap CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS will NOT alter existing tables

gotchas.symptom: Config defaults point to wrong dirs after moving the package in a container
gotchas.root_cause: REPO resolution relies on parents[3] IndexError fallback to parents[1]: valid only for /app/qianwen_engine/config.py layout (2 parent levels)
gotchas.fix: Keep the /app layout or always set DATA_DIR/SECRETS_DIR env vars explicitly (TCB sets them anyway)

gotchas.symptom: Production accidentally answers with fake answers or allows dev openid login
gotchas.root_cause: QW_DEV_LOGIN / QW_FAKE_ASK test gates left set in EnvParams
gotchas.fix: Never set these two in production EnvParams (documented as 测试双闸, 生产不设)

recipes.name: Rollback to ECS (sqlite) or between DB kinds
recipes.steps: Rollback = unset DB_KIND (config default 'sqlite' → local/ECS behavior unchanged, same code); ECS legacy link stays bit-identical. mysql mode auto-recovers idle disconnects (borrow ping reconnect), no manual ops. Engine first-connect auto-creates tables (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).
